visualCharacteristics.structure: vertically stacked horizontal cards: left text column (optional logo, bracketed stat, caption, H3, paragraph, industry tag, link), right large cover image
visualCharacteristics.summary: Three stacked horizontal case-study items: left text (optional client logo, large bracketed stat, stat caption, H3, paragraph, uppercase industry tag, 'Read the case' link), right large image

contentPattern.structure: one row per case study: image cell | text cell with optional client logo image, stat paragraph (e.g. [3 Months]), stat caption, H3, description paragraph, industry tag paragraph, and a final paragraph with a single link (makes the whole card clickable)
